This method addresses the challenges of high energy consumption and deployment costs associated with large models.

Key findings include that BitNet b1 achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art 8-bit quantization methods and half-precision models while being more efficient in terms of latency, memory, and energy usage. The paper also establishes a new scaling law for training LLMs, suggesting that 1-bit models can be both high-performing and cost-effective, paving the way for hardware specifically optimized for such models.
